story: Splitting a sum doesn't hide it: the second ¥90,000 payment opens a case on the running total.

steps.caption: Someone is paying a suspicious account in small pieces, hoping each one passes. First: ¥90,000.

do.skipIfAlerted: Earlier payments to this account are still inside the 7-day window, so the first ¥90,000 already alerts. Run with --fresh.

steps.caption: Accepted. On its own, ¥90,000 is under the limit.
A little later the same person asks for another ¥90,000 to the same account.
This time a case opens. The check looks at the running total, not just this payment.
The reason is in plain words on the card: the payments to this payee in the last 7 days, added up, including this one.

do.text: /payments to this payee in 7 days, ¥[\d,]+ in total/
